subcategory: education regulation — private schools, home education
name: Alberta — independent (private) schools and home education
description: Alberta's Education Act recognises registered independent schools (no funding, no certificated-teacher or programs-of-study requirement), accredited non-funded schools (certificated teachers) and accredited funded schools (certificated teachers, Alberta programs of study, leadership-certified principal, annual monitoring). Home education is either supervised by a willing school authority (funded; parents may claim 50% of the home-education grant; two teacher evaluations per year) or notification-only to the Minister (unfunded).

attributes.legal_term: Independent school (formerly 'private school'), Education Act ss.29(1)–(2) and Private Schools Regulation

categories.registered: Section 29(1); not eligible for funding; certificated teachers and Alberta programs of study not required, but must keep subject list and outline consistent with Ministerial learning requirements.
categories.accredited_non_funded: Section 29(2); certificated teachers required; programs of study not required.
categories.accredited_funded: Grant under the Education Grants Regulation after (normally) one unfunded year; Alberta programs of study; principal with Leadership Quality Standard certificate; annual monitoring of plans, budgets, audited statements and results reports; on-site monitoring visits.

attributes.funding_level: Operating funding commonly reported as about 70% of public base instruction rates (secondary sources: Cardus 2023, Fraser Institute) — not confirmed on alberta.ca; transportation funding 70% of public rate Gr 1–12 and 100% ECS (alberta.ca).
attributes.annual_obligations: All registered and accredited schools submit an operating plan by 15 May each year.

home_education.supervised: Notify a willing public, separate, francophone board or accredited funded independent school each year; accepted before 30 September for funding; parents may access their portion (50%) of the home-education grant for up to two years; the authority arranges at least two formal evaluations by certificated teachers per year.
home_education.notification_only: Notify the Minister (form or PASI/myPass); no program plan submission; no funding.
home_education.kindergarten_pilot: Extended to end of 2026/27; half of the full-day home-education rate each to authority and guardians.

attributes.diploma: Not addressed on the alberta.ca private-schools page; the Alberta High School Diploma depends on Alberta credits — to be confirmed per school.
attributes.online: Independent authorities may offer online learning (directory flag 'Offers Online Learning'); detailed rules not researched in Phase 1.
